factor_proposals.definition: Lower-volatility equity exposure through the actual USMV fund.
factor_proposals.limitations: No guaranteed drawdown ceiling or independent alpha.
factor_proposals.name: Previously researched low-volatility exposure
factor_proposals.rationale: Preserve the prior risk-factor family without treating repeated windows as separate factors.

factor_proposals.definition: Trailing positive price momentum as recorded in prior fixed ETF research.
factor_proposals.limitations: Prior results do not establish future alpha; ETF timing is not individual-stock evidence.
factor_proposals.name: Previously researched price momentum
factor_proposals.rationale: Preserve the already studied momentum family rather than recount it as a new discovery.

factor_proposals.definition: Issuer-described profitability, stable earnings and low debt exposure through QUAL.
factor_proposals.limitations: Related quality definitions may be highly correlated.
factor_proposals.name: Previously researched quality exposure
factor_proposals.rationale: Cash-flow accrual quality belongs to this economic family, not a new independent family.

factor_proposals.definition: Value characteristics accessed through the actual VLUE ETF in the earlier research.
factor_proposals.limitations: ETF exposure is not complete point-in-time constituent data.
factor_proposals.name: Previously researched value exposure
factor_proposals.rationale: Retain value as a distinct economic family without inventing direct historical stock scores.

factor_proposals.definition: Annual operating cash flow minus annual net income, divided by average beginning/end fiscal-year assets; higher means more cash-backed earnings.
factor_proposals.limitations: Accrual quality is related to existing quality exposures, not a proven independent alpha source. Firms with different industries/accounting treatments require comparability checks.
factor_proposals.name: Cash-flow-based accrual quality
factor_proposals.rationale: Cash and accrual components can differ in persistence. This cash-flow proxy is related to the accrual literature, not an exact replication of Sloan's original balance-sheet construction.

factor_proposals.definition: One minus fiscal-year ending assets divided by beginning assets; higher corresponds to lower annual asset growth.
factor_proposals.limitations: A factor definition is not proof of profitability. Security identities, fiscal-period alignment, delisting returns and complete historical membership are required.
factor_proposals.name: Conservative asset growth
factor_proposals.rationale: Conservative investment may differ from high-growth extrapolation. Corporate acquisitions, divestitures and changing accounting scope must remain visible rather than be removed after seeing returns.

adjusted_open_and_close: Existing validated prices cover ETFs, not the full identity-matched stock universe required for the new fundamental signals.
